newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Earthquake of 5.5 magnitude felt in Israel.
newsitem.headline: Earthquake of 5.5 magnitude felt in Israel.

text.p: An earthquake was felt throughout Israel on Wednesday morning, witnesses and officials said.
Yefim Gitterman, a scientist at Israel's Seismological Institute, said there were no immediate reports of damage or injuries from the 7.25 a.m. (0425 gmt) quake.
Gitterman told Israel Television the magnitude of the quake was estimated at 5.5 on the Richter scale.
"It seems to be in the north, possibly around Cyprus," he said, adding full details were not yet available.
